name: Zeel Desai
bio:
Career Overview: Zeel Desai is an Indian player with a strong junior background transitioning to the pro circuit.

Playing Style: Features an aggressive game with powerful groundstrokes and a competitive mindset, effective on hard courts.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #553 (August 19, 2019)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #463 (September 23, 2019)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to qualify for a Grand Slam main draw; competed in ITF events.

Notable Achievements:
  • Won 1 ITF singles title and reached multiple junior ITF finals, showcasing early promise.

Other Highlights:
  • A former top junior, Zeel is working to regain form and climb the WTA rankings.
